nip037_p: IP-TRX-CTRL 0.3.7, remote control of your radio over the internet, is out. New: HamNoise neural noise reduction for voice and CW; VOX with a button next to PTT; notes between operator and listeners, also from the browser; listeners also hear whoever transmits (handy for nets); voice squelch; QSO recording to WAV; direct IPv6 connection with ports opened via PCP, which also gets past CGNAT; server without a window for a headless Raspberry Pi; WinKeyer emulation for N1MM, DXLog and QLog. Since 0.3.6: Opus audio, several listeners on one server, USB and MIDI CW key (VBand, Vail), QSO log to GridTracker, JTAlert and Log4OM with ADIF export for LoTW, networked Icom radios with no PC next to them. GNU AGPL 3.0 licence.
nipd0532_p: IP-DESK-CTRL 0.5.32, my remote desktop, is out: with zoom set to «Fit» the remote PC only sends the pixels the window can show (less bandwidth, same result); new quality «Local network (low latency)» up to 60 frames per second, and «Automatic» goes to 50 by itself when the ping is under 12 ms; with graphics-card encoding it stays on the safe side at 30 frames per second and 12 Mbit/s.
n135_p: 1.3.5 is out: the NBS TN101 troposcatter joins as a fourth comparison model; the TN101 radio climate is chosen for each path from local ERA5 data, so it works worldwide, with the variability in 10% and 1% of the time; FT4, FT8 and Q65-15C/30B/60A digital modes; fixed masthead preamp. Forecast video lesson remade with 1.3.5, in Italian and English.
nltv_p: LIVETROPOVHF is out, my program for VHF/UHF tropospheric propagation, with two video lessons in Italian and English: the CALL3 callsign database and how to use the forecast, with the new «Details to show» panel.
n158_p: 1.5.8 is out: on the Wire antennas page the «Chart ›» button opens NEC-computed tables of lengths and counterpoises (EFHW 49:1 and 64:1, with and without counterpoise, 9:1); the Optimizer has the VHF mask SWR + G/T, which improves the G/T of a 2 x 2 stack at 30 degrees as VE7BQH does; new chapter 16 of the calculation manual and lesson 32 of the video course.
n157_p: 1.5.7 is out: on the Wire antennas page the loading coil is optional and «Tune the coil (NEC)» finds the right inductance; the warnings of all calculators are now translated and the 3D structure no longer draws wire insulation as coils.
n156_p: 1.5.6 is out: the HF calculators have a new Wire antennas page for end-fed antennas (EFHW 49:1 and 64:1, with coil, non-resonant wire 9:1 and 4:1), with six wire layouts, counterpoise, SWR per band and length tuning with NEC. Buttons open the balun, choke and quarter-wave pages already filled in; the Discone moves to VHF.
n155_p: 1.5.5 is out: the HEN calculator shows horizontal polarization, as the NEC check does, and the VNA measurements page is translated (titles, legend and correction proposal). The video course now has 32 lessons.
ngm_t: YA-MS – Geminids 2026 in Japan, Australia and South America
ngm_p: Six videos of about 2 minutes with the 144 MHz forecast for 14 December 2026 on three paths of 1400-1700 km: Sapporo (JA8) → Fukuoka, best hour 09-10 UTC; Brisbane → Melbourne, 12-14 UTC; São Paulo → Buenos Aires, 01-02 UTC. In English and in the local language. Calculation only: YA-MS's radar forecast uses Collm (Germany) and is not valid there.
nvc31_p: YA-NEC video course: two new lessons. Lesson 30, «Cables and VNA measurements», computes cable losses and the quarter-wave match and compares the NEC calculation with an .s1p measurement; lesson 31, «More calculators», shows the Loop Skywire, rectangular loop, HEN, Big Wheel, biquad and PCB antennas. The course now has 32 lessons, in Italian and English.
n154_p: 1.5.4 is out: a hand-written model without a source now gives a warning in the status bar instead of a window, error windows close with Enter or Esc, the boom correction page is translated into English. The video course is complete: 30 lessons recorded with 1.5.3-1.5.4.
nvc_p: All 30 lessons of the YA-NEC video course have been recorded again with version 1.5.3, in Italian and English, with the figures of the current version. New lesson 29, Resize and recentre: the I4GBZ 11-element Yagi taken from MMANA goes from SWR 7.4 to 1.07 in one click.
n153_p: What's new: Variables and optimization › Resize and recentre (an MMANA model or a design moved to the wanted frequency in one click, with scaled, equal or commercial diameters; trimming the driven element zeroes the reactance); Lobes and Parameters in Patterns; angle step adapted to the computer; Reception (RDF) on the open model. Fixed the 2-3 element quad in Automatic (now brought to resonance by NEC) and the double window for a model without a source. Video course re-recorded with 1.5.3, in Italian and English. If you already have YA-NEC, it updates itself automatically.
name: English
title: free ham radio software
meta_desc: Free ham radio software by Costantino Cerrotta IC8TEM: YA-NEC, YA-MS, YAEC, E-LAYER ANALYZER, IP-TRX-CTRL, LIVETROPOVHF.
hero_p: Free ham radio software by Costantino Cerrotta IC8TEM (Capri, JN70CN): antennas, meteor scatter, EME, E-layer propagation and remote control of your radio. For Windows, macOS, Linux and Raspberry Pi, in 35-37 languages, with automatic updates.
news_sub: The latest news, the same as in the Facebook group and Page.
n0_t: The IC8TEM'S SOFTWARE FARM website is online
n0_p: All the programs in one place, with the news, the video courses and the videos, a finder for the right file for every system and the full description of every program, in 10 languages.
n1_t: YA-MS – meteor scatter RA1WU ↔ IW2EQR at the Geminids peak
n1_p: Demo video (1:30): the 144 MHz forecast between IW2EQR (JN45NM) and RA1WU (KO47ES), 1890 km, for 14 December 2026, the day of the Geminids maximum (IMO: 14:00 UTC, ZHR 150). It shows the shower calendar, the Forecast calculation with Hot A/B and the recommended heading (27° instead of 37°), the hour by hour efficiency (best window 16–17 UTC on side A) and the geometry with the path loss.
n2_p: Lessons 0, 1, 13, 15, 22 and 27 re-recorded with 1.5.2, plus the new lesson 28: surveying a built antenna and the boom correction in reverse. Example: IC8TEM's 10-element Yagi on a 30 mm round boom, calculated as it is, resonates at 145.97 MHz; with Calculators › VHF › Boom correction in the sense «survey → electrical model for the NEC» it is back at 144.33 MHz, SWR 1.15, 15.7 dBi. 29 lessons in all, in order on YouTube.
n3_p: What's new: reorganised tabs (from 16 to 13: Smith in Patterns, NEC/currents, Variables and optimization); transmission lines, loads and networks drawn on the wires of the 3D structure; ground legend under the Show ground button; amateur bands shaded behind the frequency charts; Real terrain with calculation status and manual site height; Optimizer with Measures to the millimetre (commercial diameters, NEC check, cutting list); patterns, charts and cards translated in 36 languages. If you already have YA-NEC, it updates itself automatically.
n4_t: All my programs, for every system
n4_p: E-LAYER ANALYZER, YA-MS, YAEC, YA-NEC, IP-TRX-CTRL and the ones to come are released for every possible system, with an installer and a portable version you can use without installing.
prog_sub: All free. For other systems (Windows 7, ARM, Raspberry Pi, .deb, .rpm…) use the file finder for your system below.
d_yanec: NEC-2 antenna simulator for radio amateurs: wire antennas, dipoles and traps, HF beams, receiving antennas, VHF/UHF Yagis, stacks and G/T, optimizer, real terrain. Opens NEC2, MMANA, AutoEZ/MultiNEC and EZNEC files. 32-lesson video course.
d_yams: Meteor scatter 50–432 MHz: forecasts and live efficiency of meteor showers on your path, which shower works right now, best headings (Hot A / Hot B), path geometry and losses, live meteor radar data, MS spots from PSKReporter, grid-square map, technical documents.
d_yaec: Plan your EME contacts: Moon position from your locator and common windows with the DX station, Doppler and frequency correction, degradation (DGRD), link budget for Yagis and dishes, sky and solar noise. «My horizon»: your real terrain profile from elevation data, with the Moon path and the exact times it rises and sets behind your obstacles. 37 languages.
d_ela: Sporadic-E (also multi-hop and intercontinental), FAI, meteor scatter (with YA-MS built in) and radio aurora; live GIRO ionosondes and Es clouds over time. 35 languages, updates itself.
d_ip: Remote control of your HF radio over the internet: two-way AES-256 encrypted audio, CAT with Hamlib or TCI, PTT, CW keyer and decoder, digital modes on the client, access from a phone browser too. One program for both PCs: server (at the radio) and client (the operator).
tag_ela: VHF propagation via the E layer
tag_ip: Remote control of your HF radio
dl_title: Find the file for your system
dl_sub: Choose your system: the right files for each program appear, with a direct link. Below is the full table of all distributions, with search.
dl_note: «Updates itself»: with the installer, the portable version, the Mac app and the AppImage the program updates itself; with .deb, .rpm, Arch and Slackware packages it warns you and you install the new package.
dl_search: Search: program, system, type or file name (e.g. raspberry, deb, YAEC arm64)
sys_sub: Installer and a portable version you can use without installing.
sys_win: 10/11 64 and 32 bit, Windows on ARM (Snapdragon PCs) and also Windows 7 SP1, 8 and 8.1
sys_linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Mint (.deb), Fedora and openSUSE (.rpm), Arch and Manjaro, Slackware, Alpine, AppImage for any distribution
sys_rpi: Raspberry Pi OS 64 and 32 bit and other ARM boards
sys_note: The .NET-based programs don't exist for 32-bit PC Linux (i686) and OpenBSD, because .NET isn't available there; YAEC, which also runs on Mono, has packages for Linux i686 and OpenBSD too (not tested yet). With the Windows installer, the Mac app, the portable versions and the AppImage the program then updates itself.
vid_sub: Video courses, presentations and demos on the YouTube channel.
cont_sub: News, screenshots, guides, questions, bug reports and on-air results: write to me in the group or on the Page. If something doesn't work on your system, let me know!
footer: Costantino Cerrotta IC8TEM · Capri, JN70CN · ARI «Valle del Liri» section. All programs are free. 73!

js.na: Not available for this system: see the notes under «For every system».

d_ltv: Live VHF/UHF tropospheric propagation from 144 MHz up: Hepburn and F5LEN forecast maps, live spots from DX clusters, RBN, PSKReporter and your own WSJT-X/JTDX/MSHV decodes, own forecast with link budget between two stations (terrain, diffraction, troposcatter, ducts, noise, digital modes). Windows 7 too.
nyn170_p: YA-NEC 1.7, the NEC-2 antenna simulator, is out. New calculators from reading RadioRivista, RadioKit, QST and the ARRL Handbook: 2-3 element HF Yagi with tuning guide, interlaced dual-band Yagi, trap multiband vertical, inverted L / T for 160 m, half-sloper on the tower, broadband dipole, relay multiband dipole, linear loading, wire resonant on harmonics (EFLW), gamma match and stub matching with the Smith chart. Multiband quad, rectangular magnetic loop, stack spacing chosen with a click, new Tips tab. The video course has three new lessons (34-36) on what's new in 1.6 and 1.7, in Italian and English.
ny198_p: YAEC 1.9.8, the EME calculator, is out. In the My horizon tab the Moon is drawn at its true size (about 0.5°), with a dashed circle to spot it at once. The automatic update now runs only when the package's SHA-256 fingerprint is verified; links in the program open only web and e-mail addresses; on macOS the launcher checks Mono, Rosetta and quarantine and explains errors 126 and 127. If you already have YAEC, it updates itself at start-up.
nela06_p: E-LAYER ANALYZER 0.6 (up to 0.6.6): 50 MHz multi-hop chains with short hops at both ends, new HOP TABLE tab exportable to Word (how many hops from 500 to 12000 km), equal double hop up to about 4700 km (confirmed by 5U5K's QSOs), check of the alerts in the 50 MHz BENCHMARK, Es height from GIRO ionosondes, 24 and 28 MHz precursors, F.A.I. alert and 144 MHz alert from APRS, TEP forecast. The Earth is now the WGS84 ellipsoid with Karney distances, and the IGRF field is corrected (F.A.I. and aurora deviations were off by about 0.3° up to 0.6.5: declared correction). New sources, in all 35 languages.
nyms126_p: YA-MS 1.8.26 (since 1.8.23): optional tropospheric refraction from the GFS model; Japan with the HRO counts of IPRMO and Ogaki; Yagi gain from the VE7BQH average; the Earth is the WGS84 ellipsoid with Karney distances and azimuths; the program opens only once; CALL3: MMMonVHF now requires a site login, YA-MS explains it and lets you load the file with «Import CALL3.TXT...».
nip038_p: IP-TRX-CTRL 0.3.8, for security: the link to the MQTT brokers is encrypted with TLS and a verified certificate (falling back to port 1883 on networks or old PCs that cannot manage it); between two 0.3.8 programs every session has ephemeral keys (forward secrecy); a limit on all code attempts (pairing and web page) stops anyone trying to guess it.
nyn172_p: YA-NEC 1.7.1 and 1.7.2: in the 3D structure the heights (h, Δ and level heights) can be clicked and changed; in Patterns the spacing of a stack of identical antennas changes live, with the starting lobe dashed. Security: the automatic update installs only packages signed by YA-NEC and files prepared on purpose no longer close the program. Lesson 37 of the video course, in Italian and English.
nyagt101_p: New program: YA-GT 1.0.1. On a world map (Mercator or azimuthal centred on your locator) it shows who hears your callsign and who you hear, with an SNR bubble for every station: PSKReporter, Reverse Beacon Network, DM4X and DXMAPS clusters with skimmers. Switchable layers: your FT8 decodes via UDP (with re-transmission), LoTW squares, QLog QSOs, greyline, KC2G propagation and NOAA aurora. For Windows 10/11, Windows 7 and Linux.
